title: Oracle PeopleSoft register Incorrect Authorization Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Oracle PeopleSoft. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the register method. The issue results from incorrect authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account on any peer.
addtionnal_details:
Oracle has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://www.oracle.com/security-alerts/cspujun2026.html
timeline:
